long_description:
Garba, open bar, and Bollywood beats! Join Nimbu Collective for Rangili Raat: great food, dancing, and drinks for breast cancer.

About this Event

Rangili Raat is calling your name!Get ready for an unforgettable night of culture, community, and celebration! Join Nimbu Collective for Rangili Raat, a high-energy evening dedicated to celebrating Diwali and Navratri while supporting a cause that is deeply close to our hearts. Come dressed in your finest ethnic wear and get ready to experience a vibrant night filled with tradition, great music, and giving back.

What to Offer & Expect🪔 Traditional Aarti & Garba: Kick off the evening with a sacred prayer ceremony followed by an energetic open-floor Garba and Dandiya session.🎧 Live DJ Set: Dance the night away from with high-energy Bollywood hits and open-floor dancing powered by DJ Ya$h.🍲 Food & Open Bar: Enjoy delicious bites and a full open bar throughout the evening.🎨 Henna & Rangoli: Experience stunning custom rangoli installations and get beautiful designs from our on-site henna artist.✨ Special Performances & Raffles: Enjoy exclusive live performances and exciting charity raffles as part of the night's highlights.
Event Details & LogisticsDate: Thursday, October 22, 2026Time: 7:00 PM – 11:00 PMLocation: Ishq (202 Avenue A, Front A, New York, NY 10009)Dress Code: Traditional Ethnic Wear

The Heart Behind the EventThis event holds a deeply personal place in my hearts. Diwali and Navratri are my favorite holidays and are heavily celebrated in my family bringing us luck, good faith, and joy. This year, I wanted to channel that positive energy into something bigger by supporting breast cancer awareness and research. This cause is especially close to home for many, but for me it honors a beloved survivor in my family... my mother.
